Hourly footfall distribution along Kamarajar Salai (Google Popular Times)

Reading the commercial day

  • Morning Wholesale Rush (10:30 am – 12:30 pm): Peaks at 98% relative capacity as merchants deposit previous day's cash receipts and execute RTGS/NEFT vendor transfers.
  • Evening Retail Peak (6:00 pm – 8:30 pm): Highest footfall of the day (100% capacity) driven by retail shoppers in jewellery, apparel, and hardware stores.
  • Evening Cash Velocity: 41% of total daily retail customer traffic occurs between 5:00 pm and 8:30 pm.
  • Saturday Trading: Saturday volume remains at 86% of peak weekday levels, driven by family retail footfall.

Strategic rollout directive

The Kamarajar Salai commercial catchment is heavily underserved in speedy merchant banking services. Wholesale traders currently endure long waiting queues at legacy PSU counters for daily cash deposits. Opening with a dedicated Cash Deposit Machine (CDM) lobby, same-day merchant overdrafts, and a 30-minute Gold Loan counter will capture immediate high-margin market share.
Sources: Census 2011 & 2026 estimate; OpenStreetMap; Google Places Pro; RBI Branch Statistics; Property Listings Oct 2026 10
Retail Banking · Madurai Site Selection · October 2026 9 · Recommendations

Lead with Trader CASA and Gold Loans; secure signage on Kamarajar Salai.

1 · Product & Service Mix

  • Lead Products: High-volume Current Accounts (CASA) with zero-fee cash deposit allowances up to ₹10 lakh/month.
  • Instant Gold Loans: Set up a dedicated valuer desk offering 30-minute loan approvals against gold jewellery at competitive card rates.
  • Add: Merchant QR codes, point-of-sale (POS) EDC machines, and short-term working capital overdrafts.

2 · Operating Hours & E-Lobby

  • Extended Cash Desk: Keep cash collection counters open until 6:30 PM on weekdays to capture retail market closures.
  • 24/7 Dual CDM Lobby: Install 2 automated Cash Deposit Machines (CDMs) and 1 ATM in the street-facing lobby.
  • Saturday Operations: Full commercial banking services on 1st and 3rd Saturdays to align with retail bazaar footfall.

3 · Business Development Anchors

  • Trade Associations: Formal tie-ups with the Sourashtra Cloth Merchants Association and Nelpettai Grain Traders.
  • Corporate Payroll: Acquire salary accounts of nearby hospitals (Vadamalayan, Christian Mission Hospital) and trade schools.
  • B2B Payments: Offer integrated digital vendor payments and tax compliance services (GST/TDS) to local firms.

4 · Getting Found & Brand Visibility

  • Illuminated Facade: High-visibility LED totem and fascia visible from both Munichalai and Teppakulam approaches.
  • Clear Sightlines: Target property with at least 20 ft clear road frontage to guarantee visibility from passing buses.
  • Local Landmark Status: Prominently brand the 24/7 ATM lobby as a landmark cash point along Kamarajar Salai.

Leasing and floorplate analysis

  • Ground Floor Premium: Ground-floor commercial commands a 1.6x–1.8x premium over upper floors due to direct high-street retail access.
  • Space Availability: Ground-floor units along Kamarajar Salai are typically narrow (600–1,200 sq ft). Securing 1,800–2,500 sq ft requires leasing an amalgamated double-shutter space or a newly redeveloped commercial complex.
  • Lease Tenor: Typical bank lease terms require a 9-year agreement (3+3+3) with a 15% escalation every 3 years.
